title: Thirty days to answer, 48 hours if a life is at stake

quiz.q: Under the RTI Act, information about a person's life or liberty must be given within:

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Check every number and date against the listed sources.

lines.say: Since 2005, any citizen can ask a public office for information.
And the law sets a clock on the answer.

beats.say: Since 2005, any citizen can ask a public office for information. And the law sets a clock on the answer.

lines.say: The office must reply within 30 days.
Or within 48 hours, if a person's life or liberty is involved.

lines.say: Section 4 asks offices to publish information without being asked.
Section 8 lists exemptions, and Section 24 leaves out some security agencies.
